entries.title: The Town of Light
entries.definitive_edition: Steam release plus Switch Deluxe Edition extras

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for capture; view Switch Deluxe extras separately if desired.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best main route because it has the complete base game with PC capture/settings flexibility. The Nintendo Switch Deluxe Edition has exclusive documentary/making-of content, but it is a secondary route rather than the main playthrough.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Town of Light on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Use the Switch Deluxe Edition only to view its exclusive documentary/making-of extras.

secondary.exclusive_content: Deluxe Edition documentary/making-of content tied to the real Volterra asylum setting.
secondary.what_to_play: View the Switch Deluxe Edition bonus documentary/making-of material after the PC playthrough.
secondary.why: Public Switch Deluxe Edition materials describe exclusive making-of and documentary footage.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with capture/settings flexibility.

all_releases.reason: skip: same base-game route, but no sourced content or capture advantage over Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable Switch Deluxe Edition with exclusive documentary/making-of content.
all_releases.reason: secondary: lower-priority play route, but has sourced exclusive documentary/making-of extras absent from the PC main route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC is the best main playthrough route, but the Switch Deluxe Edition has exclusive documentary/making-of content worth a secondary look.

entries.remaster_caveats: Switch Deluxe Edition adds bonus documentary/making-of content rather than replacing the PC main route.
